exclusions.source_text: An Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status score of 0 or 1
History of another malignancy within 3 years before the first dose of study intervention, or any evidence of residual disease from a previously diagnosed malignancy.

Active cerebral/meningeal disease related to the underlying malignancy. Participants with a history of cerebral/meningeal disease related to the underlying malignancy are allowed if prior central nervous system disease has been treated and the participant is clinically stable
